text:
nora: FYI the JS SDK we published yesterday is causing friction for edge sample apps and editor DX. Repro: Cloudflare Worker imports @redwood/inference and crashes with 'Unexpected token export'. VSCode also complains no types.

alex: Can you paste the package.json exports you published?

nora: Minimal exports block from the package we shipped:
```json"exports": {
  \".\": {\n    \"import\": \"./dist/esm/index.mjs\",\n    \"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js\"\n  },\n  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"\n}
```

jin: Two issues likely: 1) no top-level "types" field so some editors/tsc don't locate d.ts, 2) bundlers sometimes fall back to cjs if conditional exports aren't understood, which can create mixed-format outputs and break ESM-only runtimes.

carmen: We also observed auth retry divergence: Node build runs our middleware chain and refreshes tokens on 401; edge bundle ends up not invoking retry hook because the fetch adapter path is different and middleware was tree-shaken. Result: token refresh never runs.

alex: Short term patch: add a root-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and add explicit "types" in exports. Also add a dedicated edge entrypoint under exports like "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" so workers get a pure-ESM build.

nora: I can add that in a patch release. For auth retry, we need a runtime-agnostic API: e.g. allow passing a fetch impl and a retry handler: `new RedwoodClient({ fetch: globalThis.fetch, retryHandler })`. That avoids changing existing Node behavior.

jin: Agree. Also recommend adding a CI step that does `npm pack` then installs into sample-edge and runs a tiny worker harness (wrangler dev or cloudflare worker runner) to catch these packaging regressions.

carmen: I'll open two PRs: 1) publish patch with `types` + explicit edge export, 2) SDK change to accept `fetch` + pluggable retry handler and include an edge sample using esbuild config: `esbuild({ format: 'esm', target: 'es2022', platform: 'browser', bundle: true })`.

pkg-bot: publish-check: npm pack -> smoke: FAILED (missing types, incorrect entry for edge).

alex: Good call adding the smoke. Once the patch is published I'll validate by installing the tarball in the sample and running the worker harness before merging sample PR.

nora: Thanks all, saved my afternoon. Will send the patch now. :thumbsup:
